The '''''Active''-class fast attack frigate''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The ''Active''-class frigate was the basis of the [[Surveyor-class reconnaissance frigate/Legends|''Surveyor''-class reconnaissance frigate]].<ref name="LbE" />
